title: Play-by-play
description: Every play of the game as it happens, with the score before and after. The final stays here until the next tipoff.

action.label: Play
action.description: What happened on this possession: a shot, a free throw, a turnover, a rebound or a foul. Tipoff and final bracket the game.

team.label: Team
team.description: The offense for shots, turnovers and free throws, the defense for fouls and rebounds. Three-letter team code.

player.label: Player
player.description: The player the play is about, by name: the shooter, the player who turned it over, the rebounder or the fouler. Empty on tipoff and the final.

quarter.label: Quarter
quarter.description: One to four in regulation, five and up in overtime.

home_score.label: Home score
home_score.description: The home side's points after this play.

away_score.label: Away score
away_score.description: The away side's points after this play.

clock_remaining.label: Clock
clock_remaining.description: Seconds left in the current period after this play. Published last, so a trigger on it sees the whole play.
